violation_type.title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))
violation_type.typical_finding: Four out of ten staff trainings records reviewed are missing training certificates for First Aid/CPR and health/safety annual trainings.

finding_variants.text: Four out of ten staff trainings records reviewed are missing training certificates for First Aid/CPR and health/safety annual trainings.
One out of six staff was observed to not  have the required operational policies training within the staff records. The staff hire date is 10/7/25.
Health / Safety related training certificates for four out of six staff files reviewed were not available at the time of inspection.
Documentation of current trainings for 1 staff member is still needed.

Six out of seven staff files reviewed did not have annual training hours. One of those staff files was the infant caregiver who did not have SID's, Shaken Baby, Brain Development and Child Maltreat training.
Certificates for health/safety trainings were not available for review for two out of four staff records reviewed.
